hassio_confirm.title: Notification API add-on
hassio_confirm.description: Do you want to configure Home Assistant to connect to the Notification API provided by the add-on: {addon}?

user.title: Connect to the Notification API add-on
user.description: Use this if the add-on was not discovered automatically. The values are shown on the add-on's Integration page.

data_description.host: The add-on's hostname on the Supervisor network, for example local-notification-api.
data_description.port: The add-on's API port. The default is 8080.
data_description.token: The API token shown on the add-on's Integration page.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate with the Notification API add-on
reauth_confirm.description: The add-on at {host}:{port} rejected the stored API token. Enter the current token from the add-on's Integration page. Restarting Home Assistant while the add-on is running also re-delivers the token through discovery.

data_description.token: The API token shown on the add-on's Integration page.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the add-on. Check that it is running and that the host and port are correct.
error.invalid_auth: The add-on rejected the API token.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log for details.

abort.already_configured: The Notification API is already configured.
abort.discovery_invalid_auth: The add-on rejected the token it published through discovery. Restart the add-on, or set the integration up manually with the token from the add-on's Integration page.
abort.invalid_discovery_info: The add-on sent incomplete discovery information.

auth_failed.message: The Notification API add-on rejected the API token.

update_failed.message: Could not reach the Notification API add-on: {error}
